title: 第13章 上门分礼
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 交换了很久气息，徐喜弟觉得自己要醉了，晕晕乎乎的。也不知道傻叔今晚喝的什么酒，竟这么香，这么容易醉人。所以只能由他牵着自己的手，到处乱走。肩膀很宽，很厚。喉结一会儿上一会儿下的。胸肌很结实，像一堵墙。顺下来，她像是捏到了一块块平滑又坚硬的鹅卵石。最后突然被烫得想抽回手，却让他死死按住轻轻动。黑暗里，她一张老脸热得能煎蛋。很快，轮到他了，他可不是轻轻带过那么简单的。盘累了。他把头身一低。这~徐喜弟惊得头发丝都绷得紧紧的。不像话，不像话！这会儿，傻叔真的很像一条狗，趴着腰在路边的小沟里，低头捉鱼。这傻大个，真的傻吗？……隔壁的范金花，完全不知道徐喜弟在唱什么。明明床板都没动，她为什么就唱起来了。张国海的耳朵，已经紧紧贴在木板墙上。他一连咽了好几口唾沫，也是好奇死了。办个事，至于吗？听得他的气都喘大了不少，于是默默把自己的手伸进被子里。范金花不用想就知道他是怎么回事，心里又是一阵鄙夷。笃，笃，笃。终于来正题了。这时候，张国海突然一个翻身，就爬上来。范金花心中不免一阵惊喜。可最后，张国海也只是扭了几下屁股，又下去了。什么玩意儿！她反脚就是一踹，直接把人蹬到墙缝里。动静还挺大，但隔壁似乎一点都没有影响，只管摇自己的床板。……又累到了深夜。他今夜也不着急走，搂着她，把头埋在她颈间。脚还勾搓着她的脚。可她太困了，眼皮合上，就快速进入了梦乡。他万般不舍地用手一遍遍摸着她的脸颊。此刻多想和她相拥而眠。竟开始渴望天长地久了......哎……他轻轻叹了一口气，翻身离开。……不例外，徐喜弟一觉醒来，又差不多中午了。刚出房门，就看到堂屋墙角堆着两大袋快挤爆的猪菜。她愣了愣，傻叔还真是有使不完的力气！辛苦到大半夜，这么早就给割好猪菜了，一看又是两三天不用她进山了。去后院涑口，远远地看到小羊山的位置，在冒着浓烟。徐喜弟愣在那里，端着水瓢，心里再次感慨。傻大个刘烨，这个点也就在小羊山那里烧山了。开荒第一件事，就是把杂草杂树割干净，堆到一起放火烧。然后用踩犁一小片一小片翻土，把草根翻在上面晒。遇到树根就用钉锄刨根。那座小羊山，能让他至少忙活两三个月！正发着呆，一个身影从岔路口朝他们家走过来。刘宇宁提着一个挎篮，来到院墙前，笑着跟徐喜弟打招呼。“喜弟，刚起床呢？”“昂~”徐喜弟有些不好意思，日上三竿才起床，被撞见就算了，还给当面说出来。但他们关系熟，她也不怕他笑话。“宇宁哥，你这是要上哪儿？”刘宇宁把手里的挎篮亮了亮，“给你们家送点糯米饭和糍粑。”原来是来分礼的。村里都有习俗，有客人送礼上门（主要是糯米饭、糯米糍粑，和糖果），等客人走了，主家就会把礼分一分，送到同村的亲友或者关系亲近的人家。“爱棉就回去了吗？”徐喜弟还有些遗憾，昨天说午饭后过来家里坐坐，今天不到中午就走了。昨天当那些汉子的面，她们连一些姐妹间体己的话都没说。“表弟妹们吃过早饭，就赶时间回去了，但是玉娟（妹妹）还在。”刘宇宁说着，也没往堂屋的正门走，就站在院墙外，把篮子送进来。“你来拿一下，我给烨哥家也送一点。”“不进来坐坐吗？”徐喜弟一脸茫然。人都到门口了，还不进家，肯定是他妈交代的！全村人都不爱登张国海家的门。王秀菊不乐意刘宇宁上家里来，也不是这几天才有的事。尤其现在，他们家日子过得越好，他们就越瞧不上张国海一家。“快过来拿呀。”刘宇宁见她站着不动，又把篮子往里递了递。徐喜弟往火房里看了看，范金花像是听到了后院的动静，好奇出来看。在门口看到院墙外的刘宇宁，眉头就皱了起来。刘宇宁看到范金花，知道这一趟门是不得不进了。只好打了一声招呼，“婶，我给家里送点糍粑来。”说完，绕到正门，从正院进门。……刘宇宁一进门，就看到张国海从屋里出来，嘴上还骂骂咧咧的。两人四目对了一下，张国海才算挤了个笑脸，“宇宁来了。”“叔，我送点糍粑来，昨天表弟妹们过来了。”他一边说着，一边随意地把挎篮放在堂屋的祭案上。张国海瞟了一眼，满满的一个挎篮，一半是糯米饭，一半是白糍粑，上面还放了一抓彩皮糖。这些东西，他们家一年到头也吃不上几回。糯米饭还好，三月三和清明节要做一点，还有中元节要做。白糍粑只有送礼和办喜事才会捣。他忍不住咽了咽。“哥，是你回来了吗？宇宁哥！刘宇宁！”屋里的张永福听见了堂屋的动静，激动地叫刘宇宁的名字。“呃……是我回来了。”刘宇宁应了一声，朝张永福所在的屋走过去。才到门口，一股酸爽的味直冲天灵盖，床上的人精神也很差，面色苍白，整个人看上去很颓废。“阿福，你是哪里不舒服吗？”刘宇宁咬咬牙，走到床边。张永福一下就拉住了他的手，脸上掩饰不住的激动，“你什么时候回来的？”“怎么才来看我？”“还回去吗？”“带媳妇回来了吗？”“你变化可真大啊！成才了！”一连串的话，问得刘宇宁险些招架不住，捡了重要的回答。“回来两天都在帮家里修屋顶。我以后在镇上工作，过两天就去报到。”“阿福，我看你精神不太好，要是哪里不舒服，我送你去镇上医院看看？”“真的吗？”张永福一听说去镇上，眼睛就发亮。
content_en: After exchanging breaths for a long time, Xu Xidi felt that he was getting drunk and dizzy.I don’t know what kind of wine Uncle Silly drank tonight, but it was so fragrant and intoxicating so easily.So he could only hold her hand and walk around.The shoulders are broad and thick.The Adam's apple goes up and down from time to time.The chest muscles are strong, like a wall.Along the way, she seemed to be pinching smooth and hard pebbles.Finally, he was suddenly burned and wanted to withdraw his hand, but he was forced to hold it down and move it gently.In the darkness, her old face was so hot it could fry an egg.Soon, it was his turn, and it was not as simple as taking him lightly.Tired of dishes.He lowered his head.This~Xu Xidi was so shocked that his hair was taut.It’s outrageous, it’s outrageous!At this moment, Uncle Silly really looked like a dog, lying on his back in the ditch on the roadside, lowering his head to catch fish.Is this stupid guy really stupid?...Fan Jinhua next door had no idea what Xu Xidi was singing.The bed board wasn't even moved, so why did she start singing?Zhang Guohai's ears were already pressed tightly against the wooden wall.He swallowed several times in a row, and he was so curious.Just do something, okay?Hearing that he was breathing heavily, he silently put his hand into the quilt.Fan Jinhua knew what was going on with him without even thinking about it, and felt a wave of contempt in her heart.Beneath, bee, bee.Finally let’s get to the point.At this time, Zhang Guohai suddenly turned over and climbed up.Fan Jinhua couldn't help but feel pleasantly surprised.But in the end, Zhang Guohai just twisted his butt a few times and went down again.What the hell!She kicked him back and pushed him into a crack in the wall.The noise was quite loud, but the neighbor didn't seem to have any influence at all and just shook his own bed board....I was tired until late at night again.He was not in a hurry to leave tonight, he hugged her and buried his head in her neck.His feet were still rubbing her feet.But she was so sleepy that she quickly fell asleep as her eyelids closed.He reluctantly touched her cheek with his hand over and over again.At this moment, I want to hug her and sleep with her.He actually began to long for eternity... Sigh... He sighed softly, turned over and left....No exception, when Xu Xidi woke up, it was almost noon again.As soon as I walked out of the room, I saw two large bags of nearly overcrowded pork vegetables piled in the corner of the main room.She was stunned, Uncle Silly really had endless strength!After working so hard until midnight, she had cut the pigs and vegetables so early. It seemed that she wouldn't need to go into the mountains for another two or three days.I went to Sukou in the backyard and saw thick smoke rising from Xiaoyang Mountain in the distance.Xu Xidi was stunned there, holding the water ladle, feeling emotional again.Stupid Liu Ye, at this point, he will burn the mountain at Xiaoyang Mountain.The first thing to do when clearing the land is to cut away the weeds and trees, pile them together and set them on fire.Then use a plow to turn over the soil in small pieces, and turn the grass roots on top to dry.When you encounter tree roots, dig them with a nail hoe.That little sheep mountain can keep him busy for at least two or three months!While they were in a daze, a figure walked towards their home from the fork in the road.Liu Yuning came to the courtyard wall carrying a basket and greeted Xu Xidi with a smile."Xidi, did you just get up?" "Ang~" Xu Xidi was a little embarrassed. He didn't get up until three o'clock in the morning. He just ignored him and said it to his face.But they were familiar with each other, and she wasn't afraid of his jokes."Brother Yuning, where are you going?" Liu Yuning flashed the basket in his hand, "Send some glutinous rice and glutinous rice cake to your family." It turned out that he was here to share gifts.It is a custom in the village that when guests come to their doorsteps, they bring gifts (mainly glutinous rice, glutinous rice cakes, and candies). When the guests leave, the host family will distribute the gifts to relatives and friends in the same village or to people with close relationships."Ai Mian, are you going back?" Xu Xidi was still a little regretful. Yesterday he said he would come over to sit at home after lunch, but he left before noon today.Yesterday, in front of those men, they didn't even say anything to each other as sisters."The cousins ​​​​had breakfast and went back in a hurry, but Yujuan (sister) is still there." Liu Yuning said, without going to the main entrance of the hall, he stood outside the courtyard wall and sent the basket in."Come and get some, and I'll send some to Brother Ye's house." "Why don't you come in and sit down?" Xu Xidi looked confused.Everyone has arrived at the door. If you still don’t enter the house, your mother must have told you!Everyone in the village didn't like to visit Zhang Guohai's house.Wang Xiuju didn't like Liu Yuning coming to her house, and it wasn't something that happened only in the past few days.Especially now, the better their family's life is, the less they look down on Zhang Guohai's family."Come here and get it." Seeing her standing still, Liu Yuning handed the basket inside again.Xu Xidi looked into the fire room. Fan Jinhua seemed to have heard the movement in the backyard and came out to take a look out of curiosity.When he saw Liu Yuning outside the courtyard wall at the door, he frowned.When Liu Yuning saw Fan Jinhua, he knew he had to enter this time.I had no choice but to say hello, "Auntie, I'll bring some glutinous rice cakes to your house." After saying that, he walked around to the main entrance and entered from the main courtyard....As soon as Liu Yuning entered the door, he saw Zhang Guohai coming out of the room, cursing.The two looked at each other before Zhang Guohai smiled and said, "Yuning is here." "Uncle, I will send you some glutinous rice cakes. My cousins ​​came over yesterday." As he spoke, he casually placed the basket on the memorial table in the main room.Zhang Guohai glanced at it and saw a full basket, half of which was glutinous rice and half of which was white glutinous rice cake, with a handful of colorful candies on top.Their family couldn't eat these things many times throughout the year.Glutinous rice is okay, I will make some for March 3rd and Qingming Festival, and also for the Hungry Ghost Festival.White glutinous rice cakes are only made when giving gifts and celebrating weddings.He couldn't help but swallow."Brother, are you back? Brother Yuning! Liu Yuning!" Zhang Yongfu in the room heard the movement in the main room and called Liu Yuning's name excitedly."Uh... I'm back." Liu Yuning responded and walked towards the house where Zhang Yongfu was.When we arrived at the door, a sour smell hit Tian Ling Gai. The person on the bed was also in low spirits, his face was pale, and he looked very decadent."Afu, are you feeling uncomfortable somewhere?" Liu Yuning gritted his teeth and walked to the bed.Zhang Yongfu immediately grabbed his hand, unable to hide the excitement on his face, "When did you come back?" "Why did you come to see me?" "Go back?" "Did you come back with your wife?" "You have changed so much! You have become a talent!" After a series of questions, Liu Yuning almost couldn't resist, and he picked up important answers."I've been helping to repair the roof at home for the past two days since I came back. I will work in the town and report for duty in two days." "Afu, I see that you are not in good spirits. If you feel uncomfortable, I will send you to the hospital in town for a check-up?" "Really?" Zhang Yongfu's eyes lit up when he heard that he was going to the town.
